::: {#rem-simulation-estimate-bayesian}
#### Simulation estimates in Bayesian inference

The [Monte Carlo estimate](bayesian-inference.qmd#def-monte-carlo-estimate) of a [posterior](bayesian-inference.qmd#def-posterior) [expectation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-expectation)
is the same [average](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-vectors.html#def-mean), taken over draws from a [posterior distribution](bayesian-inference.qmd#def-posterior)
instead of over [replications](#def-replication) of a [data-generating process](#def-data-generating-process).
:::
